span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Over long delays only the hippocampus can hold complex high-resolution bindings, so its necessity grows as the delay lengthens and other cortical stores drop out
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Cortical perceptual binding regions lose their representations as delay grows, presumably through interference from incoming sensory input, shifting the load onto the hippocampus
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms

span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms

span.label: the same representations should be available without any long delay, which is why they could serve working memory and perception too

span.label: over short delays other cortical mechanisms can hold such bindings, so the hippocampal contribution only becomes visible as the delay grows

span.label: the domain matters as well as the resolution: simple associations need the hippocampus in long-term memory but not in working memory, and in perception only complex materials do

span.label: Whether recollection in working memory can occur without the hippocampus is only indirectly supported.

span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS PRECISION AGAINST CAPACITY. 'Quotation withheld' Both are ways of being worse at a memory task and a summary score cannot tell them apart - so a deficit reported without this distinction is compatible with two different accounts of what the hippocampus does. Cowan2008 in this corpus reports the same literature unable to decide whether its limit is time or capacity; here a third quantity is separated from capacity by measurement. Q-483. · strength of the relation: 1 — the patients keep the second and lose the first, which an overall accuracy score would merge

span.label: Reviewing the patient literature, hippocampal damage impairs perception and working memory precisely on tasks demanding complex high-resolution bindings.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The same patients are largely spared on tasks that need only coarse or simple associations, which is why earlier studies found no hippocampal involvement.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In a colour-wheel working memory task, hippocampal damage degraded the precision of the remembered colour rather than the number of items retained.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In a same/different scene task the patients' perceptual deficit was confined to strength-based (relational match) responses, while state-based responses using local feature detail were intact.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In healthy participants, hippocampal fMRI activation scaled linearly with strength-based perceptual confidence and showed no extra rise for state-based responses.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Merely requiring an association does not predict hippocampal involvement, since some object-colour associative working memory tasks are performed normally after hippocampal damage.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Hippocampal involvement is not restricted to complex scene material: precise colour memory for coloured squares also depends on the hippocampus.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The threshold of complexity at which the hippocampus becomes necessary differs across domains: simple associations need it in long-term memory but not in working memory.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In long-term memory, selective hippocampal damage removes recollection while leaving familiarity-based recognition intact.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: At a one-second delay hippocampal patients failed on object-location pairings while remaining normal for the objects and the locations on their own.
